title: Barnaby Beaver Who Refused to Sleep: Why Bodies Need Rest!

lines.text: Barnaby the busy beaver wanted to build the tallest wooden dam on the river!
lines.caps: Barnaby the busy *BEAVER | wanted to build the tallest wooden dam on the *RIVER!

lines.text: Bedtime! called his parents. But Barnaby insisted, Sleeping is a waste of time!
lines.caps: Bedtime! called his *PARENTS. | But Barnaby insisted, Sleeping is a waste of *TIME!

lines.text: He gnawed on birch logs under the moonlight, refusing to close his drooping eyes!
lines.caps: He gnawed on birch logs under the *MOONLIGHT, | refusing to close his drooping *EYES!

lines.text: By sunrise, his head felt heavy as a boulder and his paws turned to wobbly jelly!
lines.caps: By sunrise, his head felt heavy as a *BOULDER | and his paws turned to wobbly *JELLY!

lines.text: He missed a branch, dropped his favorite chisel, and tumbled splash into the river!
lines.caps: He missed a branch, dropped his favorite *CHISEL, | and tumbled splash into the *RIVER!

lines.text: Doctor Owl pulled him ashore and explained, Sleep is your body's charging station!
lines.caps: Doctor Owl pulled him *ASHORE | and explained, Sleep is your body's charging *STATION!

lines.text: While you snooze, your brain sorts memories and your muscles rebuild superhero strength!
lines.caps: While you snooze, your brain sorts *MEMORIES | and your muscles rebuild superhero *STRENGTH!

lines.text: Barnaby curled up for a cozy eight-hour nap and woke up ready to build world wonders!
lines.caps: Barnaby curled up for a cozy eight-hour *NAP | and woke up ready to build world *WONDERS!

lines.text: Recharge your superpower sleep and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
